items.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
items.snippet: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer
items.title_ar: MemOnce: بنية memory قابلة للتوسع لموديلات LLM
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة MemOnce، وهي بنية أساس تتعلم memory states قابلة للتوسع للموديلات اللغوية في التفاعلات الطويلة والمستمرة. تعتمد على memory encoder-decoder يخزن جزءاً صغيراً فقط من final-layer KV caches بدلاً من تراكم cache كامل لكل طبقة وكل token، لتجنب النمو الخطي في GPU memory والتعقيد التربيعي. الهدف الجمع بين كفاءة linear-time architectures والحفاظ على التفاصيل الدقيقة.
items.why_ar: يهمك لأنه يعالج مشكلة نمو memory في LLM agents طويلة التشغيل، وهي تكلفة مباشرة في أي نشر إنتاجي.
items.title_en: MemOnce: a scalable memory architecture for LLMs
items.summary_en: The paper introduces MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models in long-horizon interactions. It uses a memory encoder-decoder that caches only a small subset of final-layer KV caches instead of full layer-wise token caches, avoiding linear GPU memory growth and quadratic compute. The goal is to combine the efficiency of linear-time architectures with retention of fine-grained details.
items.why_en: It addresses memory growth in long-running LLM agents, a direct cost driver for production deployments.

items.title: Intent Contracts: Taking Tools Away from Agents
items.snippet: Intent contracts are an authorization interface for tool-using LLM agents in which the planning model holds no tools. For each step it submits a short logged contract: a goal, a verbatim quotation of the user, and scope fields. Code validates the contract, and a small trusted model checks it against the user's words and writes the tool call itself. Provided the validation and dispatch code is correct, every executed call is written by the trusted model, the planner's influence on a call is confined to a contract logged before it, and the trusted side decides how much of a request to carry out. We compare contracts with two reviewers of planner-written commands: one sees only the user's words
items.title_ar: Intent Contracts: سحب الأدوات من agents للتفويض الآمن
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة Intent Contracts، وهي واجهة تفويض لـ tool-using LLM agents حيث يملك موديل التخطيط صفر أدوات. يقدم المخطط contract مسجلاً يحوي goal واقتباساً حرفياً من المستخدم وحقول scope، ثم يتحقق الكود منه ويكتب موديل موثوق صغير استدعاء الأداة بنفسه. تقارن الورقة هذا النهج بمراجعين لأوامر المخطط.

items.title_en: Intent Contracts: taking tools away from agents
items.summary_en: The paper proposes Intent Contracts, an authorization interface for tool-using LLM agents in which the planning model holds no tools. For each step the planner submits a logged contract with a goal, a verbatim user quotation, and scope fields. Code validates the contract, and a small trusted model checks it against the user's words and writes the tool call itself.
items.why_en: Directly applicable to authorization and audit design for tool-calling agents in a regulated bank.

items.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.snippet: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can
items.title_ar: StereoVLM: نماذج Vision-Language ثنائية العين للاستدلال المكاني المتري
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث StereoVLM، وهو نهج يستخدم الرؤية الثنائية المعايرة مع VLM لتحسين الاستدلال المكاني ثلاثي الأبعاد. يشرح النص أن الهندسة عبر الكاميرات تقلل الغموض الذي تعاني منه النماذج الحالية.

items.title_en: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.summary_en: The paper proposes using calibrated stereo vision with VLMs to improve metric 3D spatial reasoning. It argues that explicit cross-view geometry reduces the ambiguity found in current models that infer 3D structure from single or multiple uncalibrated images.
items.why_en: It is relevant to your research because it addresses grounding VLM spatial predictions in geometric evidence instead of semantic priors.

items.title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
items.snippet: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. items.title_ar: تتبع الكائنات عبر التحولات الفيزيائية: TTU وTIPO
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث Transformation Tracking and Understanding، وهو توسيع لتتبع الكائنات ليشمل التجميع والتفكيك الفيزيائي. يقترح نهج TIPO للحفاظ على حالة الكائنات وتعيين تسميات دلالية للتحولات، ويشير إلى قصور foundation models مثل SAM 2 وSAM 3 في هذا السياق.
items.why_ar: يهمك لأنه يطرح تحسيناً على video tracking مع foundation models، وقد يفيد مشاريع الرؤية الحاسوبية في تحليل المستندات أو العمليات المادية.
items.title_en: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
items.summary_en: The paper introduces Transformation Tracking and Understanding, extending video object tracking to objects that assemble and disassemble. It proposes TIPO to maintain a state graph of relationships and assign semantic labels to transformations, noting that foundation models like SAM 2 and SAM 3 cannot update semantic identities as objects change.
items.why_en: It matters to you because it addresses a gap in foundation-model tracking that could affect computer vision POCs involving changing objects.

items.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
items.snippet: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level
items.title_ar: AgentRoboCritic: قدرات frontier agents في التحكم المباشر بالروبوت
items.summary_ar: تحلل الورقة أداء frontier multimodal agents في التحكم المباشر بالروبوتات عبر 12 manipulation benchmarks، بدلاً من الاكتفاء بنسب نجاح الحلقات. تقدم AgentRoboCritic، وهو إطار نقد يربط كل action بـ intent محلي ويقيّم نتيجته وطريقة فشله. الهدف فهم كيف ينجح الagents ولماذا يفشلون على مستوى كل action.
items.why_ar: يفيدك في تقييم agents للأتمتة بمنهجية أدق من نسبة النجاح الإجمالية.
items.title_en: AgentRoboCritic: frontier agents on direct robot control
items.summary_en: The paper provides an action-level analysis of frontier multimodal agents performing direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks, rather than only episode success rates. It introduces AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework where the agent states a local intent per action and a critic judges the outcome and failure mode. The aim is to show how agents succeed and where they fail.
items.why_en: It offers a finer-grained evaluation methodology than episode success rates for any agent you evaluate.

items.title_en: Eskor uses AI and alternative data for citizens' credit scoring
items.summary_en: Eskor uses AI and alternative data to assess the creditworthiness of citizens. The source does not specify the market or the type of alternative data used.
items.why_en: It is a practical example of AI-based credit scoring, close to bank lending work.

items.title: Praxis Tech launches AI Rule Builder for payment routing rules - The Paypers
items.snippet: Praxis Tech launches AI Rule Builder for payment routing rules The Paypers
items.title_ar: Praxis Tech تطلق AI Rule Builder لقواعد توجيه المدفوعات
items.summary_ar: أطلقت Praxis Tech أداة AI Rule Builder لإنشاء قواعد payment routing. وفق عنوان الخبر، تركز الأداة على تسهيل كتابة قواعد توجيه المدفوعات باستخدام AI.
items.why_ar: أداة AI لقواعد المدفوعات تقابل عملاً تشغيلياً في البنك يمكن نمذجته وتجربته.
items.title_en: Praxis Tech launches AI Rule Builder for payment routing
items.summary_en: Praxis Tech has launched AI Rule Builder, a tool for creating payment routing rules. The announcement is brief and focuses on applying AI to payment operations.
items.why_en: An AI-assisted rules tool for payment routing maps directly onto banking operations an engineer could prototype.

items.title: السعودية والذكاء الاصطناعي... من التقنية إلى القيمة الحكومية - صحيفة مال
items.snippet: السعودية والذكاء الاصطناعي... من التقنية إلى القيمة الحكومية صحيفة مال
items.title_ar: السعودية والذكاء الاصطناعي: من التقنية إلى القيمة الحكومية
items.summary_ar: يتناول مقال في صحيفة مال مسار الذكاء الاصطناعي في السعودية، من الجانب التقني إلى تحقيق القيمة في الخدمات الحكومية. النص المتاح هو العنوان فقط دون تفاصيل إضافية.
items.why_ar: يعطي صورة عن توجه الجهات الحكومية السعودية نحو تبني AI، وهو سياق مفيد لاختيار أولويات المشاريع.
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia and AI: from technology to government value
items.summary_en: An Al-Mal newspaper article examines Saudi Arabia's AI path, from technology to value in government services. Only the headline was available, so details are limited.
items.why_en: It gives context on Saudi government adoption of AI that may shape project priorities.
